verdict.summary: The #1121 regression test exercises the production run_sweep terminal-reap path at the load-bearing fresh-read boundary. All three cases hold the expired lease and empty snapshot constant while independently varying the direct issue read: an open, non-terminal issue retains its claim, whereas a true 404/absence and a closed issue release it. The expected tuple checks both the reclaimed count and the exact release set, preventing a universal no-reap implementation from satisfying the safety leg, and the exception wrapper turns crashes into mismatching values without aborting later checks. The fixture also uses literal stable-order listing paths rather than production-derived expectations. The added rationale accurately limits the ascending-pagination residual and identifies why direct revalidation makes a skipped open row safe. No production behavior or trust check is changed, no injected reviewer instruction appears in the diff, and no correctness, soundness, security, or test-validity defect is evident. With no findings in either round 6 or round 7, progress is stagnant under the required scale.
